balls.text: full and straight, on the middle and off, driven down to Habrhajan at long-off for a single
fullish, outside off, Ryan drives to right of sweeper cover and hustles back for the second run
the bouncer around off stump and Lee stabs it to left of short third man where Jonty Rhodes incarnate Munaf Patel rushes across to make a fab lunging stop!
shuffles across to outside off and goes for the big pull but the bat slips out of his hands! The ball rolls out to midwicket.
Humongous! It's a full-length  delivery outside off, right in the slot and tenDO absolutely wallops it over long-off. Way back into the stands
yorker length on the off stump line, dug out towards long-on and since the ball rolls out slowly, they have time to rush back for the second
full and well outside off, just inside that white line, Lee tries to reach out and carve it but can't connect
This one lands. Full and outside off, Ryan slashes it to right of Malinga at third man
Hmmm .. another full toss, hint of in swing, Lee punches it to long-off
The full tosses keep coming. Ryan crashes this straight to deep point.

Bhatia is run out It was another low full toss, swinging in from outside off, driven to left of long-off. Rohit collects and releases the throw quickly. Very accurate too. Dhawal breaks the bails before a diving Bhatia can gets his  bat inside the crease.
pushes it wide outside the off stump.
Wham. Dhawal serves a low full toss outside off  and tenDo swipes it to the midwicket boundary
full and straight, pushed out past Malinga for a single. Fine spell from Lasith
yet another slower one, Bhatia edges the defensive poke on to his pad and Ryan calls him over for a quick single
fullish, outside off, Ryan brings up his fifty with a steer to backward point. KKR camp gives him a standing ovation. Fine knock so far.
on the middle stump line ,turned behind square-leg
another slower one, full and outside off, steered to backward point

The slower one works. Shakib had moved outside leg and Malinga follows him with a slower one. Shakib was too early into his pull shot and fails to connect. The ball hits his left thigh and falls on the stumps! Good cameo but it's over now
yorker length well outside off, Ryan tries to reach it but can't. he looks at the umpire, as if to suggest, ' wasn't that a wide?'
full in length, on the middle stump line, dragged to deep midwicket
slower one around off stump, run down to third man
Low full toss outside off and ten DO crashes it to the cover boundary. Thwack!

fuller, outside off and Shakib gets another edge, as he tries to slug that, to third man. Dhawal waits for the ball to land and prefers to just field it. Munaf isn't too impressed. He thinks Dhawal should have gone for the catch
starts off with a bouncer and Shakib edges the pull to fine-leg boundary. He was beaten for pace and by the extra bounce but got the edge
yet another slower one, it beats Shakib who went for a cut and bounced over the stumps. Rayudu lunges to make a half-stop as it bounced before it reached him. They steal a bye.
slower one outside off stump, pushed out to point for a single
moves down the track and has to check the shot as it was a slower one: he adjusted well to push it down to long-off
Top shot! He moved outside leg and drove the very full delivery straight past Malinga. Long-on intervened to cut it off
sprays this full delivery down the leg side for a wide
goes for the yorker, it dips on the leg stump line, almost on the boot, squeezed down to fine-leg
slings across a low full toss outside off and Shakib inside edges the waft to fine-leg
back of length outside off, from round the stumps, punched to covers
clips this short of length to deep backward square-leg
in the zone outside off and the keeper collects

edged past a lunging keeper. Dhawal delivered this from around the stumps and got this one to cut back in with bounce. Shakib was cramped for room and he ended up chopping it to left of Rayudu who lunged out but couldn't reach in time. A proper keeper would have perhaps got it
presses back, waits for the length delivery to angle away from him and plays it very late. He steers it down to the third man boundary. Very nicely done
Crunchy! It's a length delivery outside off and Shakib creams it through wide mid-off. Lovely hit on the up.
short in length outside off, Ryan tries to cut but ends up edging and stabbing it down the track
on the leg stump line and short as well  and Ryan slams this to the square-leg boundary

Stumping chance missed. Ryan rushed out of the crease early and Harbhajan fired it short of length and very quickly down the leg side. Rayudu shuffled across but it was too quick for him and he didn't take it cleanly
full and outside off, from round the stumps, Ryan goes for a slog sweep but misses
lands on the off stump line, on a length, on the off, pushed out to midwicket
gets back to punch this to covers
works this through the on side for a single

The bouncer trick does the job for Munaf. The first bouncer flew over the keeper, the second was swatted to fine-leg, the third was lobbed over midwicket and now this. It was the short ball outside off, around chest-high, and Yusuf went for a flat-batted whack. The ball lobbed towards left of long-on where Pollard rushed across to take it very safely.

another one banged in short and Yusuf doesn't quite connect well with his pull shot. He makes contact with the top half of the bat but the ball lobs into vacant spaces between deep midwicket and long-on
shuffles right across the stumps and swats a short-of-length delivery down to fine-leg fielder for a single
full in length, straightening on the off stump, pushed out to the off side of the pitch and Yusuf wants a single. His partner doesn't as Munaf Jonty Patel was on to the ball very quickly
Munaf goes for another short delivery, at the body this time, Yusuf laps it around the corner for a single
The bouncer arrives and Munaf goes for the pull. He is beaten for pace but gets a big fat edge and the ball soars over the keeper
gets back to swat this to short fine-leg
moves around the stumps now, slows up the pace on it and Yusuf flat-bats it back to Harbhajan who makes a good stop
Tonked! Harbhajan tries the quick delivery but serves a low quick full toss. Slam. Yusuf crash-lands it to the straight boundary
back around the stumps for the lefty and this has been pushed past the bowler for a single. Ryan came down the track and pushed the short -of-length delivery wide of Harbhajan
from over the stumps, a low quick full toss on the legs  and Yusuf misses out. Just a single to long-leg
from round the stumps, floated around off, turned to square-leg
Violent thump! Yusuf clears his front foot and kills this full delivery to the straight boundary. Whack.
on drives this for a single
Bosh! He picked the full delivery from outside off and slugged it over long-on.
short and wide - a rare loose delivery - and Ryan slams it with a square-cut to the point boundary
gets forward to push this back down the track
length delivery just outside the off stump, Ryan is caught on the shuffle as he tries to push it to the off and is hit on the pad outside off
presses right back to work this to left of short fine for a single
top spinner outside off, Ryan squeezes it wide of the lone slip
leans forward to ping long-on
leans forward to work this to square-leg region
Almost yorked! It was tossed up in the air but dipped rapidly and landed on the blockhole. Ryan was stunned; he tried to dig it out but missed. The ball went past the off
quickish skidder on the off stump line, nudged away to backward point
slower one just outside off, nudged to cover point
slower one outside off, tapped to left of backward point for a single
leans forward to drive this to covers
full and straight, flicked to the on side
on the pads again, turned quietly to long-leg for a single
full in length, drifting to the pads, Yusuf tries to whip it up and over square-leg but misses. The ball rolls off the pad
It's a short ball. Ryan arched back and pulled it just over square-leg boundary. Franklin walks away from the crime scene.
short in length outside off, cut away for a single
turns this one for a single

Shout for lbw Franklin came in around the stumps and got the ball to nip back in from outside off. It was almost on the off stump line when Ryan decided to run it down to third man for a single. No room. No breathing space. The ball kept coming in and he tried to stab it away. And the ball hit the pad flap around the off stump line and would have hit the top of the off stump.
around the off stump line, guided to cover point
crouches to cut this back-of-length delivery to deep point
closer to the off stump, straighter, run down to third man
Edged between the keeper and extremely wide slip. Four! It was a lovely length delivery tilting away from Ryan, who lunged out to defend. The ball flew off the edge and right into the gap
outside off stump, steered to backward point

Too hot to handle! It was a lifter, a bouncer around the off stump line, Ryan shaped to pull but the ball was too quick for him. The ball hit the bat as opposed to the other way around and rolled out to the on side
gets across to tap this length delivery to the off side
lands on a length outside off and seams away, Ryan thinks about chasing it before he lets it go
skids outside off stump, chopped down to third man
drifts to the pads and Ryan unfurls the leg glance to pick up a boundary.
fullish, Ryan gets the bat in front of the pad to push it away

Tiwary, you got to walk. He has to stop staring at the umpire and has to move. And he does so, eventually. He shuffled across and was caught on the move. The ball skid in to hit him in front. It would have taken out the top of the leg stump. Crash! KKR are swaying away like drunken men.
taps this gently to the on side for a single
Sloggy! Brother yo has a big swing outside off. Blink. The keeper collects the ball
short delivery again, this one doesn't doesn't lift as much, tapped to square-leg
Ouch Screaming bouncer! And the ball hits the bat handle. He took his eyes off the ball and tried to duck; he also put his bat up as a face shield and the ball crashed into the handle.
just outside off stump, defended to the off
short in length, straight on the stumps, tapped to the on side
just outside the off stump line, guided to backward point
length delivery just outside off, steered to backward point
gets back to tap the back-of-length delivery to point
shows respect this time. He leaned forward to defend the length delivery
The slog-o-rama continues! Yusuf wanted to drag-pull this back-of-length delivery from outside off to the leg side. The ball limped away towards mid-off
full and straight, Yusuf plays around the front pad and drags it to midwicket

Oh boy! KKR is imploding spectacularly. Spontaneous combustion. It was a short ball- Kallis had told him to look out for the short ball - Goswami backed away and had a wild slog at it. Cramped for room. Edge and gone! Munna is all smiles.
angling in towards the middle stump line , jabbed away from the crease
turns towards middle stump, tapped to wide midwicket region

Harbhajan roars. And why not? He has taken out KKR's captain. It landed on a length around leg and middle and skidded towards the off stump. Gambhir went for the slog sweep but missed it completely. Now then .. now then...!
taps this off break to extra cover
full delivery and Gambhir seemed as if he wanted to jump down the track but ended up lunging forward and jabbing out at it
lands just outside leg and turns towards off and middle, from over the wicket, Gambhir stabs it to the off .. ball rolls to the keeper
rushes down the track and lifts it inside out over covers
pushes this length delivery back down the track
length delivery angling away , pushed out to point

Munna bhai strikes. It was another full delivery, Kallis goes for the off drive but ended up slicing it a bit - Munaf had delivered it with a scrambled seam and that perhaps held up a bit - towards left of mid-off. Enter SRT into the act. He moved to his left and lunged out to pouch a low catch. Inches off the turf and all that jazz.
Classy! Full pitched outside off stump, Kallis leans well forward to crash it through wide mid-off.
leans forward to drive the full delivery to covers
around waist-high full toss , a surprised Kallis jabs it to square-leg.
length delivery outside off and Kallis plays a neat on-the-up square drive but Pollard makes a fine diving save to his left at cover point
good delivery, straightening on a full length on the middle and off line, pushed out to mid-on
in the zone outside off stump, left alone
gets forward and tries to clip the length delivery off his pads but misses and collects a leg bye. It had pitched outside leg stump
the scorecard ticks over with a wide down the leg side.. Gambhir tried to play the leg glance but didn't connect
around the off stump line, stabbed away to point
leans forward to drive the full delivery to the off side

Game over! Crunched for a six! Harbhajan roars. Tendulkar smiles. Gautam's face drains out of expressions. Harbhajan rushed down the track and slugged it over wide midwicket boundary. Nice and easy. KKR out of the tournament. Mumbai Indians stay in. Tendulkar, for some reason still padded up, walks out to the middle to congratulate his team-mates. Huge smiles, as you would expect in the Mumbai camp.
slow through the air, outside off, driven to long-on for a single Bhaji on strike

Dot ball. Lee gets close to Harbhajan. They talk. It was a bouncer that went past the attempted pull. Goswami threw the ball back to Lee who caught it and kept on walking towards Harbhajan who walked towards him and eventually past him. Chat. Wicked fun.
Lee goes around the stumps and keeps this full and straight, Franklin drives it to long-on
Low full toss time. Franklin drives to left of sweeper cover. Harbhajan wants the second. Franklin is late. Ryan makes a sliding save and fires the throw but Franklin gets back in time
ah! another really full delivery, almost a yorker and Bhaji was almost lbw. The boot seemed in the way but somehow he crouched and got the bat just in time ahead of the boot to dig it out to long-on!
goes for the yorker this time, Bhaji digs it out, lee leaps to bring it back
Lucky top edge! It was a lovely bouncer at the body, a cramped-up Harbhajan is late on the pull but top edges it to his helmet grill and it flies to the fine-leg boundary!

Crumble rumble! Shakib is da man tonight. Suman implodes. It was tossed up slowly on a length around off and Suman goes down the track and chips it to Manoj at long-off. The ball popped up but he held it on the rebound and then lobs it up and kicks it off his right foot
flighted up on a length on the middle, Suman goes down the track and pushes it back to the bowler
leans forward to tap it to left of cover for a single. Very calmly done.
slower, on the middle and off, turned to midwicket
leans forward to ping long-off. Shakib throws in a desperate dive but can't reach
around off stump, Franklin taps it quietly to left of backward point

full and on the middle and leg line, Suman leans forward to defend and almost chips it back to the bowler. It landed short. Iqbal shuffled to his right and got behind Franklin. Perhaps a more desperate diving effort was needed. Not sure whether he would have got it even if he tried but it was worth the laundry bill
on the leg and middle, spins on to the pad and rolls away
Nicely done! Wider outside off, Franklin presses back, waits on that back foot and cuts it late well to the left of short third man
this one was delivered from a round-armish angle and it skidded on outside off, Franklin was beaten, lunging forward to defend
full and around off stump, punched out to sweeper cover
shortish outside off, cut away to deep point region
leans forward to defend to the on side
this one grips and turns past the defensive poke. Slip and silly point

Trapped! Shakib Al Hasan nails Pollard. It landed on a length on the middle and skidded on with the arm. Pollard pushed outside the line and the ball skidded on to hit the pad. That would have taken out the leg stump. Ooh la la. More fun awaits us. The game keeps turning and churning. hawk eye suggests it would have missed the leg stump.
skids on outside off from short of length, punched out to sweeper cover
slower, outside off, cut to left of backward point where Lee makes a diving stop
full and outside off, driven wide of sweeper cover for couple of runs
sharp lifter outside off and Pollard sways away from the line of fire. Supah spell from Jacques.
short in length around off, run down to third man
hurls across a high bouncer and Franlin lets it fly past him. Kallis runs on through his follow through and stares. Franklin stares back.
full in length, from round the stumps, pushed out to covers
This one kicks up from back of length, it screams up at a surprised Pollard who stabs it off his chest to short cover region.
just outside off, on a length, cut away for a single
from round the stumps, short delivery, pulled to right of deep midwicket for couple of runs
slower, full and outside off, driven to sweeper cover
Balaji tries the bouncer but he doesn't get much pace behind it; Franklin pulls it away to the backward square-leg boundary
full in length outside off, driven on the up to right of Lee at long-off
full in length, around off, pushed down the track
full in length, skidding across, Franklin gets an inside edge to fine-leg
jabbed out to the off for a quick single
fullish, on the middle and leg, turned through square-leg

Ambati Rayudu can't believe it! It was a bouncer outside off and Rayudu went for a cut. The ball flew through to the keeper. Kallis and Goswami celebrate. Rayudu actually had a wry smile as if to say why are you guys celebrating, I didn't nick it. The camera panned to the umpire Asad Rauf who put his finger up. Rayudu's visage turned grave. he can't believe it but he has to go. Hope they show another replay. There doesn't seem to be any deviation nor noise. No snicko or hot spot of course to really nail it down.
the quicker bouncer outside off and Rayudu pulls it down to midwicket
over-pitched but well outside off, Rayudu looks to cream through the off side but he is far from the pitch.
bumped away violently. Short ball from Kallis, angling in nicely, Rayudu moves quickly inside the line and thumps the pull emphatically through midwicket.
full and straight on off stump, Rayudu plays it back down the track
ends the over with a back of length ball outside off, Rayudu slaps into the covers for a single.
kitchen sink through the off side. Rayudu jumps up, opens up the off side and gets a juicy length ball well outside off. He throws everything at it to squeeze a boundary backward of point
tentative. Rayudu doesn't quite get across to the line and then pokes uncertainly outside off to a length ball that held its line.
Rayudu calmly gets behind the line of a length ball angling in, and defends.
a little more room this time, Franklin forces him away into the covers for a single.
he starts with a short of length ball. Not a full toss, note the point! Franklin stays on the crease and steers without timing to point
back of a length, on the hips and he turns it away to midwicket for a quiet single.

Now then.. Do we have anything special looming over the Wankhede Stadium. Kallis hurled another bouncer, this time at the body of Tendulkar who tried to pull it. Cramped for room and done in for the pace and bounce. Tendulkar gets a top edge on that very awkward pull and the ball lobs to backward point
the quicker bouncer outside off this time, Tendulkar tries to steer it through slips but doesn't connect
tries the slower bouncer, Tendulkar opens his stance, waits for the ball to arrive before pulling it to the wide midwicket boundary
length delivery outside off, slashed away to wide third man where Lee makes a neat sliding stop
full and outside off, Rayudu drives it down the track and Kallis stops it with is right boot. and smiles.
short and outside off stump, cut away to sweeper cover
full and straight, Rayudu mistimes the drive to mid-on
presses back to punch this back of length delivery to sweeper cover
on the middle , tucked down to fine-leg region
banged in short outside off, left alone
on a length around off stump line, pushed through point
full in length around off, defended to the off side
stays back to cut it to off for a single
the bouncer arrives and Tendulkar goes for the pull but the ball climbs over the blade.
gets back to defend it to the bowler

Rohit Sharma is run out It was punched to mid-on off the back foot and Rohit set off. Tendulkar sends him back but Rohit had rushed too far across. Direct hit and he is gone. Sachin is angry at Rohit for running so far down. He makes his displeasure known. Rohit trudges back to the hut. Tendulkar had taken a start after playing that shot but said no almost immediately but Rohit had moved too far down the track by then
gets back and across to punch this out to mid-off
short again, tucked away to the on side for a single
Lee bowls this fuller and Blizzard slashes it straight to deep point fielder. Very fine hand from Blizzard. He has put Mumbai on course here.
Carved! 50 for Blizzard. It was the bouncer on the off and middle line, Blizzard had already moved outside and cut it hard over backward point boundary. it flew to the upper tier.
backs away and flat-bats the third short delivery of the over up and over mid-off. It wasn't as short as the other two and he whacked it
digs it in short again, Blizzard backs away and tries to cut it. But is beaten for pace again. Goswami appeals for a catch. Lee doesn't.
a sharp lifter from round the stumps and it flies past the attempted pull. Too quick for Blizzard
on a length around off, cut to Gambhir at point
outside the off stump, cut away to point
Knifed! Bhatia tries yet another slower one but Adrian reads this early and gets down on his knee to swing it cleanly over wide long-on. Whoosh!
another slower one, pushed out to Kallis at extra cover
slower one around off and middle, punched down to long-on
on the pads, turned to fine-leg
gets back to punch it down to long-on
on the leg stump line, paddled to short fine for a single
gets down on his knee to sweep it to deep square-leg fielder
too full to cut but Blizzard tries and edges it to the off
The game hurtling along at a frenetic pace. It was short and wide, Blizzard crashes it to the cover boundary.
Thumping sweep! it was a short of length delivery and he short-arm pulled it to square-leg boundary
turns in from outside off, cut to point
SRT is in some mood tonight. He goes for that sweep again and though he gets a top edge he clears the backward square-leg fielder very comfortably
Wow! He leaned forward, allowed the top hand to go  slightly limp and used the bottom hand to scoop it high over wide mid-off
More cuteness! This time he leaned across, waited, collapsed his arms and plays a paddle-swat to right of short fine-leg fielder
Placement! He leaned across, picked this full delivery from outside off and sweeps it to backward square-leg boundary
slower, from round the stumps, Blizzard shapes to defend and the ball rolls off the pad
gets back to punch this to long-on
Swipe! low dipping full toss around off stump and Blizzard swipes that full toss to wide long-off boundary
on the pads, turned to backward square-leg fielder
Crashed! He leans forward to thump this flighted full delivery to the straight boundary.
very full, Blizzard goes for the sweep and it goes off his glove to short fine
short in length, skids on towards middle stump, pulled to deep midwicket. Blizzard stepped out for the second but got back in time
skids in towards the off, with the arm, defended to short extra cover
backs away to cut this really hard but its intercepted at cover
floated outside off, Tendulkar is hit on the pad, trying to paddle sweep it. It hit him just outside off stump on the thigh pad
quickish delivery, swatted away to backward square-leg fielder
on the off stump line, punched down to long-off
on the pads, tucked away to right of short fine-leg
on the off stump line, defended back to the bowler
on the leg stump line, rolls off the pad to short fine
full and on the middle, swept to left of short fine for a single
fetches the length delivery from outside off and sweeps it aerially over square-leg. He just went for placement there; no violence
around the off stump line, Tendulkar punches it neatly through extra cover
flighted on a length on the middle, eased to mid-on
fullish, on the off stump line, Blizzard drags it across the line past square-leg
Crunched! Another length delivery outside off and Adrian punches it on the up and through extra cover
Sliced! It was a length delivery outside off and Blizzard slashed it up and over point. It flew off the outside edge
full in length, just outside off, Tendulkar leans across, opens the bat-face and runs it down to third man
drags this short outside off and Blizzard drag-pulls it through wide midwicket for three runs
back of a length and skidding away from the batsman who reaches out to cut and gets a bottom edge. The ball rolls to the left of slip where Kallis dives to stop it
